svg.title: Terraform plans
svg.desc: 3 independent states. Resource identities and relationships are scoped to each state.

svg.title: Terraform plan
svg.desc: 2 resources, 1 reference edges. Arrows point from dependencies to dependent resources. References are conservative, not Terraform execution order. Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified.
